# Stova Media | Custom Software Development Agency & AI Agent Studio

> Stova Media is a premier custom software engineering studio and AI agent agency based in Kolkata, West Bengal, India. We architect, design, and ship high-fidelity web applications, autonomous AI agent systems, healthcare SaaS solutions, and e-commerce platforms for serious businesses worldwide.

## Company Overview
- **Legal Name**: Stova Media
- **Founder & Lead Architect**: Mehedi Hasan
- **Location**: Kolkata, West Bengal, India
- **Website**: https://stovamedia.in
- **Email**: contact@stovamedia.in / stovamedia@gmail.com
- **Phone**: +91 9432053261
- **Business Model**: Outcome-based fixed pricing, 100% in-house engineering, zero outsourcing, custom architecture (no templates).

## Core Capabilities & Services

### 1. Custom Software Development
Full-stack web applications, healthcare SaaS platforms, enterprise dashboards, and custom white-label solutions built from scratch.
- **Tech Stack**: Next.js, React, Node.js, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, Prisma, Supabase, Tailwind CSS, Python.
- **Key Focus**: Scalable architecture, low-latency 2G/3G optimization, offline-first clinical queues.

### 2. AI Agent Studio & Agentic Automation
Custom autonomous AI agents, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, conversational bots, and intelligent workflow automation systems built for production.
- **Tech Stack**: OpenAI GPT-4o / Gemini models, Python, FastAPI, RAG architectures, LangChain, LlamaIndex, Vector Databases.
- **Key Focus**: 24/7 autonomous customer engagement, lead qualification, clinical photo-to-3D simulation.

### 3. Local Business Growth Package (GMB + Premium Web)
Google Business Profile optimization paired with a high-converting, custom-coded web platform for local business market dominance.
- **Special Offer**: Offered at ₹15,999 (Market value ₹25,000).

### 4. Custom E-commerce Architecture
Scalable digital storefronts with brand-aligned design systems, secure payment integration, and inventory management.
- **Special Offer**: Upto ₹39,999 (Market value ₹55,000).

## Portfolio & Case Studies

1. **Mr Compounder** (Healthcare SaaS)
   - *Overview*: Silent OPD token & queue management platform for Indian clinics. No patient app install required; operates seamlessly on 2G.
   - *URL*: https://www.mrcompounder.com
   - *Impact*: 50+ active clinics, 100% availability, zero barrier queueing.

2. **Hair Transplant Simulation / HairViz** (AI & 2D/3D Platform)
   - *Overview*: AI-driven photo-to-3D hair transplant visualization platform for cosmetic surgeons. Generates scalp models, designs hairlines, calculates graft counts, and animates Month 1-18 growth timelines.
   - *Impact*: Interactive hairline design tool, white-labeled for international clinics.

3. **Dr. Paul's Online Care** (E-commerce Platform)
   - *Overview*: Doctor-recommended clinical hair & skin care e-commerce platform for Dr. Paul's Multispeciality Clinic (17+ clinics across India & Bangladesh).
   - *URL*: https://care.drpaulsonline.com
   - *Impact*: 1.5s page load speed, multi-clinic fulfillment integration, doctor-curated recovery kits.

4. **Bondhu Motor & Electronic** (Local Business & Web Platform)
   - *Overview*: High-conversion digital presence paired with local GMB dominance for an electric vehicle showroom.
   - *URL*: https://bondhumotorandelectronic.netlify.app/
